process.stop: Ctrl+C in the fixture exec session, or send SIGINT to that exact fixture PID.

fixtures.imageAndCopySource: Public default seeds reused in test-only synthetic products; categories reassigned only in memory.

checks.name: public categories are a flat whitelist array, slugs, active custom and zero, sorted deterministically
category counts include active out-of-stock, exclude draft and archived, retain zero
green line pages 20 + 3, exact category subset and no repeated IDs
product order sortOrder ascending then createdAt descending
omitted category lists all active products, totals cannot be derived by summing visible categories
category lowercases and trims, matches exact slug only
custom slug accepted, zero and unknown return valid empty metadata, inactive category not enforced by list
all sentinel is not a backend category; empty omitted category uses all
out-of-range page preserves total and defaults remain page1 limit20
real ValidationPipe rejects invalid page, limit, status, repeated category and unknown query
public status override cannot reveal draft and stock filtering is independent of category count
default category upserts remain in memory and do not replace pre-existing categories
loopback CORS accepted without credentials; external origin gets no permission
independent synthetic 503, malformed and empty wrappers are clearly labelled
synthetic delay still uses real service; aborted request cancels fixture timer

limits: No MongoDB connection or real aggregation execution; find/sort/aggregate/upsert are in-memory model simulations.
503, malformed and forced-empty responses bypass controller/service and are synthetic fixture wrappers.
Delay is injected before routing; normal successful delayed responses use the real controller/service.
This report does not validate physical Expo Go, mobile UI, production data or deployment.
